title: Residents protest outside house in Kyiv Oblast over detained servicemen
seoTitle: Kyiv Oblast protest over detained servicemen

tea.why: Residents gathered after social media reports claimed armed people were illegally holding and beating servicemen in a basement.
tea.want: Protesters demanded answers regarding the alleged illegal detention and abuse of mobilized and absent-without-leave servicemen.
tea.changed: Nov 2: Clashes occurred outside the building involving tear gas, warning shots, and the intervention of officials including Kyrylo Budanov.

summary: On November 2, 2026, roughly 100 to 200 people gathered outside a private home in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka near Kyiv, following social media reports that mobilized troops and AWOL soldiers were being held and beaten in the basement. Residents and relatives attempted to storm the property, throwing eggs, flares, and water bottles at law enforcement and National Guard personnel guarding the location. Police and National Guard officials stated the building was used as a temporary deployment and transition point for mobilized men. The situation escalated into clashes involving tear gas and warning shots, prompting the arrival of senior officials including President’s Office Head Kyrylo Budanov.
demands: Release of detained servicemen from the facility
response: Police and National Guard officials stated the reports of illegal detentions were false, explaining the building was a temporary deployment point. The response included deploying law enforcement, using tear gas, firing warning shots, and hospitalizing four men.

crowd.text: about 100 people according to one journalist, and roughly 200 people according to another report

injuries.text: four men were brought out and hospitalized, with journalists reporting one had a broken spine

updates.text: Residents gathered outside a house in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka following social media claims of illegal detentions.
Clashes erupted between protesters and security forces, with objects thrown and warning shots fired.
National Guard commander Oleksandr Pivnenko and President’s Office Head Kyrylo Budanov arrived at the scene.

sources.title: Crowd gathers outside house near Kyiv where mobilized troops and AWOL soldiers were being held. Clashes erupt, shots are fired, and Zelensky’s chief of staff intervenes. — Meduza

conflicts: Sources differed on crowd size, with one report stating about 100 people and another estimating roughly 200 people.
